parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for human ATP-dependent translocase ABCB1. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Filter by target name 'ATP-dependent translocase ABCB1' and organism 'Homo sapiens', standard_type 'IC50', and require docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all raw activity rows; do not use DISTINCT. Cast activity_comment to NULL if it contains non-integer strings like 'Not Active'.
